proof.text: Take the natural transformation beta supplied by the left-inverse theorem. Component monicity implies monicity of the exchange transformation by NatTrans.mono_of_mono_app. Cancel that transformation on the right of alpha beta alpha = alpha, using beta alpha = identity, to obtain alpha beta = identity.
